work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent CXCIII 58228, synopsis 58231–58234 and full papal self-protocol 58236–58240 introduce the complete current confirmation and observance/derogation/closing provisions 58284–58361. Incorporated predecessor constitutions are explicitly abbreviated by Omittitur residuum 58268–58269 and Reliquum ... habes ibid 58281–58283; these omissions belong to quoted earlier instruments and are preserved literally. Current full/short dating 58363–58368 and papal subscription 58371–58373 are followed by the cardinal subscriptions through 58632 and attached publication attestation 58638–58654, which explicitly calls these supradictae litterae. Current date correction 58386–58387 is retained; printed dates are not normalized. Real next CXCIV starts 58657, with its separate note 58664–58672 excluded. Entire expanded signature sequence and body read coherently.
